simple.summary: כָּסִפְיָא (Kâçiphyâʼ) means Casiphja , a place in Babylon First listed occurrence: Ezra 8 17.

definitions.full: H3703. Kasiphya כָּסִפְיָא proper name, of a location in Babylonia, site un-known : — ׳בְּכ הַמָּקוֺם Ezra 8:17 (twice in verse) ᵐ5 B ἐν ἀργυρίῳ , ᵐ5 L ἐν Μασφεν Esdr a , τῶν γαζοφυλακίων, γαζοφύλαξιν Esdr β . כֶּסֶת see below II. כסה .
